scene.ko: 영화가 끝난 뒤 로비에서 직장 동료와 서로 다른 감상을 나누다가, 놓친 쿠키 영상 이야기를 듣는다.

lines.en: So, what did you think? I'm curious.
Honestly, I loved it. The visuals were stunning, and the soundtrack really pulled me in.
lines.ko: 솔직히 너무 좋았어요. 영상미가 굉장했고, 음악에 완전히 빠져들었어요.
alt: To be honest, I loved it. It looked amazing, and the music really drew me in.
I really loved it. The visuals were beautiful, and the music was great.

lines.en: Really? I thought the story dragged a bit in the middle. I almost fell asleep!
lines.ko: 그래요? 저는 중간에 이야기가 좀 늘어지는 것 같았어요. 거의 잠들 뻔했어요!

lines.en: I can see why you'd say that. But for me, the slow part made the ending hit even harder.
lines.ko: 무슨 말인지 알 것 같아요. 그래도 저는 느린 부분 덕분에 결말이 더 크게 와닿았어요.
alt: I get what you mean. But I think the slow part made the ending more powerful.
I understand. Still, the slow part made the ending stronger for me.

lines.en: Fair point. But did you get the ending? Was the captain alive or not?
lines.ko: 일리 있네요. 그런데 결말 이해했어요? 선장이 살아 있는 거예요, 아닌 거예요?

lines.en: I think they left it open on purpose. The director wants us to decide for ourselves.
lines.ko: 일부러 열린 결말로 둔 것 같아요. 감독이 관객 스스로 판단하길 바란 거죠.
alt: I think the ending is open on purpose, so we can decide ourselves.
I think they did that on purpose. We're supposed to decide.

lines.en: Maybe. Wait, did you stay for the scene after the credits?
lines.ko: 그럴지도요. 잠깐, 크레디트 끝나고 나온 장면 봤어요?

lines.en: No way, there was one? I went to the restroom as soon as the credits started. What happened?
lines.ko: 진짜요? 그런 게 있었어요? 크레디트 올라가자마자 화장실에 갔거든요. 무슨 장면이었어요?
alt: Really? There was a scene after the credits? I left for the restroom. What was it?
Seriously? I missed it. I was in the restroom. What happened?

lines.en: I won't spoil it. Let's just say it answers my question about the captain.
lines.ko: 스포일러는 안 할게요. 선장에 대한 제 질문에 답이 나온다고만 해 둘게요.

lines.en: Now I have to see it again! Do you want to go this weekend? Popcorn's on me.
lines.ko: 이제 다시 봐야겠네요! 이번 주말에 같이 갈래요? 팝콘은 제가 살게요.
alt: Now I need to watch it again! Want to come this weekend? I'll buy the popcorn.
I have to go back now! Shall we go this weekend? Popcorn is on me.

expressions.en: I can see why you'd say that.
They left it open on purpose.
